user.title: Connect to AudioMuse-AI
user.description: Enter the address of your AudioMuse-AI server. Version {min_version} or newer is required.

data_description.api_token: AudioMuse-AI → Setup Wizard → API token. Only needed when authentication is enabled in AudioMuse-AI; leave empty otherwise.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the AudioMuse-AI API token
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {url} is no longer accepted. Enter the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach AudioMuse-AI at that address.
error.invalid_auth: AudioMuse-AI rejected the request. If authentication is enabled in AudioMuse-AI, enter its API token.
error.unsupported_version: This AudioMuse-AI server reports {version}; version {min_version} or newer is required.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This AudioMuse-AI server is already set up.

data_description.default_count: Used when an action does not give a song count.
data_description.default_player: A Music Assistant speaker to play new playlists on when none is chosen.
data_description.ai_provider: Leave empty to use the provider set in AudioMuse-AI.
data_description.ai_model: Leave empty to use the model set in AudioMuse-AI. Pick a model that supports tool calling.
data_description.ai_server_url: Only for OpenAI-compatible services. Leave empty to use AudioMuse-AI's setting.
data_description.music_assistant_provider: Only needed if playback fails or you have several Music Assistant providers for the same server type: the Music Assistant provider instance ID. Navidrome, Jellyfin, Emby and Plex are detected automatically.

entry_not_found.message: No loaded AudioMuse-AI server has that config entry ID.

entry_required.message: Several AudioMuse-AI servers are set up; choose one with config_entry_id.

no_player.message: Choose a speaker, or set a default speaker in the AudioMuse-AI options.

no_music_assistant.message: Playback needs the Music Assistant integration.

no_ma_provider.message: Playback is not available for this music server: Music Assistant has no music provider for it (for example Lyrion), or it is not recognised. Set 'Music Assistant provider' in the AudioMuse-AI options if Music Assistant does have one.

instant_playlist.name: Instant Playlist
instant_playlist.description: Get songs from your library for a request (AI pick or quick text search), save them as a playlist and optionally play it.

config_entry_id.name: AudioMuse-AI server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one.

prompt.name: Request
prompt.description: What you want to hear, in plain words.

mode.name: How to pick songs
mode.description: AI pick asks AudioMuse-AI's AI (needs an AI provider). Quick search uses AudioMuse-AI's text search: faster, no AI needed.

count.name: Songs
count.description: How many songs. Defaults to the integration option.

name.name: Playlist name
name.description: Defaults to the request text. AudioMuse-AI adds "_instant".

save.name: Save playlist
save.description: Save to the music server. Turn off to only get the song list.

play_on.name: Play on
play_on.description: A Music Assistant speaker to start the playlist on.

similar_artists.name: Similar artists
similar_artists.description: Find artists in your library that sound like a given artist.

config_entry_id.name: AudioMuse-AI server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one.

artist.name: Artist
artist.description: Artist name as it appears in your library.

count.name: How many
count.description: Number of similar artists to return.

artist_playlist.name: Artist playlist
artist_playlist.description: Make a playlist from an artist and the artists that sound most like them.

config_entry_id.name: AudioMuse-AI server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one.

artist.name: Artist
artist.description: Artist name as it appears in your library.

count.name: Songs
count.description: How many songs. Defaults to the integration option.

name.name: Playlist name
name.description: Defaults to "[artist] and similar". AudioMuse-AI adds "_instant".

save.name: Save playlist
save.description: Save to the music server. Turn off to only get the song list.

play_on.name: Play on
play_on.description: A Music Assistant speaker to start the playlist on.

config_entry_id.name: AudioMuse-AI server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one.

run_radios.name: Refresh Radios
run_radios.description: Create or refresh one playlist per enabled AudioMuse-AI Radio.

config_entry_id.name: AudioMuse-AI server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one.

play_playlist.name: Play playlist
play_playlist.description: Play a music-server playlist on a Music Assistant speaker.

config_entry_id.name: AudioMuse-AI server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one.

playlist_id.name: Playlist ID
playlist_id.description: The ID returned when the playlist was saved.

entity_id.name: Speaker
entity_id.description: Defaults to the speaker set in the options.
